Copy On this page Technical Library Artificial Intelligence Zoom AI Whitepaper The Zoom AI Whitepaper for Zoom Workplace, Webinars, and Events Welcome to Zoom's Artificial Intelligence Whitepaper documentation for Zoom Workplace, Webinars, and Events. How to Use this Document These pages explain how Zoom uses artificial intelligence across its products and services for Zoom Workplace, Webinars, and Events. Other Zoom products are not currently included across these pages. Some sections describe shared AI capabilities that support many features across the platform, while other sections explain specific features one by one. Because Zoom’s AI capabilities are broad and often work in different ways depending on the product, this document is organized into sections that move from general platform concepts to more specific features and data flows. Disclaimer This document is provided for informational purposes only. It describes and illustrates AI features and capabilities across the Zoom platform, but it does not guarantee that any feature, capability, integration, or service described here is currently available based on account or deployment environment. Access to and use of these features may depend on factors such as subscription plan, license assignment, administrator settings, regional availability, product configuration, technical compatibility, credit availability, usage limits, and other commercial or operational requirements.  // Step 1: Normalize "Zoom Team Chat" → "Team Chat"
  const ZOOM_TEAM_CHAT_REGEX = /Zoom(?:\s|\u00A0| )*Team(?:\s|\u00A0| )*Chat/gi;

  // Step 2: Replace "Team Chat" variations → "Zoom Chat"
  const TEAM_CHAT_REGEX = /Team(?:\s|\u00A0| )*Chat/gi;

  const SKIP_TAGS = new Set(["SCRIPT", "STYLE", "NOSCRIPT", "TEXTAREA", "CODE"]);

  function processTextNode(node) {
    let value = node.nodeValue;

   
    if (!value || value.indexOf("Team") === -1) return;


    if (value.indexOf("Zoom") !== -1) {
      value = value.replace(ZOOM_TEAM_CHAT_REGEX, "Team Chat");
    }


    const finalValue = value.replace(TEAM_CHAT_REGEX, "Zoom Chat");

    if (finalValue !== node.nodeValue) {
      node.nodeValue = finalValue;
    }
  }

  function processSubtree(root) {
    const walker = document.createTreeWalker(
      root,
      NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT,
      {
        acceptNode(node) {
          const parent = node.parentNode;
          if (!parent || SKIP_TAGS.has(parent.nodeName)) {
            return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
          }
          return NodeFilter.FILTER_ACCEPT;
        }
      }
    );

    let node;
    while ((node = walker.nextNode())) {
      processTextNode(node);
    }
  }

  function init() {
    processSubtree(document.body);
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init, { once: true });
  } else {
    init();
  }

  const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
    for (const mutation of mutations) {
      for (const node of mutation.addedNodes) {
        if (node.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) {
          processTextNode(node);
        } else if (node.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE) {
          if (!SKIP_TAGS.has(node.nodeName)) {
            processSubtree(node);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  });

  observer.observe(document.documentElement, {
    childList: true,
    subtree: true
  });

  function getFromParam(name) {

    var r = window.location.search.substr(1).match(reg);
    if (r != null) return decodeURIComponent(r[2]);
    return '';

  // Immediately hide header and footer
  if (getFromParam('onlycontent') === '1') {
    const hideElements = () => {
      const header = document.querySelector('header');
      const footer = document.querySelector('footer');
      const invitation = document.querySelector('.livesdk__invitation');
      const consent = document.querySelector('#onetrust-consent-sdk');

      if (header) header.style.display = 'none';
      if (footer) footer.style.display = 'none';
      if (invitation) invitation.style.display = 'none';
      if (consent) consent.style.display = 'none';
    };

    hideElements();

    const observer = new MutationObserver(hideElements);
    observer.observe(document.documentElement, {
      childList: true,
      subtree: true
    });
  }

  // Immediately replace hyperlinks with spans if 'nohyperlink' parameter is 1
  if (getFromParam('nohyperlink') === '1') {
    const replaceLinks = () => {
      var links = document.querySelectorAll('a');
      links.forEach(function (anchorElement) {
        var spanElement = document.createElement('span');
        spanElement.innerHTML = anchorElement.innerHTML;
        anchorElement.parentNode.replaceChild(spanElement, anchorElement);
      });
    };

    replaceLinks(); // Run immediately

    // Use MutationObserver to catch dynamically added links
    const linkObserver = new MutationObserver(replaceLinks);
    linkObserver.observe(document.documentElement, {
      childList: true,
      subtree: true
    });
  }

  // Once the page has fully loaded, perform link adjustments for 'onlycontent' param
  window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    if (getFromParam('onlycontent') === '1') {
      var mainLinks = document.querySelectorAll('main a');
      mainLinks.forEach(function (link) {
        var href = link.getAttribute('href');
        if (href && href.indexOf('mailto:') > -1) {
          var textInsideAnchor = link.textContent || link.innerText;
          link.outerHTML = textInsideAnchor;
        }
        if (href && href.indexOf('mailto:') === -1) {
          var params = window.location.href.slice(window.location.href.indexOf('?'));
          var baseUrl = href.split('?')[0];
          link.setAttribute('href', baseUrl + params);
        }
      });
    }
  });

    <div class="accordion__item">
        <button class="accordion__item-button js-accordion-trigger">
            What is Zoom Canvas?
        </button>
        <div class="accordion__item-content js-accordion-panel">
            
<p>Zoom Canvas — formerly known as Zoom Docs — is an AI-powered collaborative content and workspace tool that transforms team discussions and meetings into shareable documents, wikis, tables, and forms. It's designed to help teams collaborate more effectively before, during, and after meetings by automatically generating content blocks with drag-and-drop functionality.</p>
        </div>
    </div>


    
    <div class="accordion__item">
        <button class="accordion__item-button js-accordion-trigger">
            How is Zoom Canvas different from Zoom Paper?
        </button>
        <div class="accordion__item-content js-accordion-panel">
            
<p>Zoom Canvas and Zoom Paper are both AI-powered, collaborative document creation and productivity apps.</p>
<p>Zoom Paper is designed for traditional document structure. It's a more formal word processor designed to bridge the gap between the old world of legacy docs and the new world of collaborative content creation. With Zoom Paper, you can build formatted documents in printable page layouts that you can also turn into templates for organization-wide use.</p>

<p>Build living, highly collaborative documents with Zoom Canvas's block-based, drag-and-drop editing, or design within the boundaries of a quintessential document in Zoom Paper — with margins, headers and footers, pagination, and so on. What is Zoom Canvas? Zoom Canvas — formerly known as Zoom Docs — is an AI-powered collaborative content and workspace tool that transforms team discussions and meetings into shareable documents, wikis, tables, and forms. It's designed to help teams collaborate more effectively before, during, and after meetings by automatically generating content blocks with drag-and-drop functionality. How is Zoom Canvas different from Zoom Paper? Zoom Canvas and Zoom Paper are both AI-powered, collaborative document creation and productivity apps. Zoom Paper is designed for traditional document structure. It's a more formal word processor designed to bridge the gap between the old world of legacy docs and the new world of collaborative content creation. With Zoom Paper, you can build formatted documents in printable page layouts that you can also turn into templates for organization-wide use. Zoom Canvas, meanwhile, is designed for collaboration across multiple digital content formats, from shared docs and wikis, to tables and forms. Zoom Canvas's strength lies in its versatility and adaptability, especially for teams needing features like meeting notes and project timelines. Build living, highly collaborative documents with Zoom Canvas's block-based, drag-and-drop editing, or design within the boundaries of a quintessential document in Zoom Paper — with margins, headers and footers, pagination, and so on. No matter which solution you're using, you're getting powerful AI assistance, real-time collaboration, and the ability to templatize your documents to help you and your team save time and be more productive. Is there an additional cost for Zoom Canvas? Zoom Canvas is included with your paid Zoom Workplace license. If you do not have a Zoom Workplace license, you can purchase it to get the most out of our Zoom AI Productivity Suite. Can I get Zoom Canvas à la carte? Zoom Canvas is available as part of our Zoom Workplace bundles or Zoom AI Productivity Suite. Is AI Companion included with Zoom Canvas, or does it cost extra? AI Companion is baked into every tool in Zoom's AI Productivity Suite, including Canvas. Each AI Productivity Suite license includes AI credits that power intelligent features; however, we’re currently offering unlimited credits until May 30th to help teams experience the full capabilities of the suite. Features and capabilities are subject to applicable usage limits, availability, and AI credit balances. Certain functions may require additional subscriptions or credits.
